address: 55 Baring Street, Islington, London, N1 3DS, United Kingdom
bio: It may look like just another renovated pub in a smart residential street, but the food here displays far more imagination and ability that usual gastropub fare. There are influences from across Europe, with dishes that are uncluttered yet full of flavour; the quail shish is already a favourite starter for many. They’ve gone for cool simplicity with the décor; and service that is warm and outgoing....
